title: DCT Tracker — 10-5-5 (Meta Flex) mode
description: Opt-in 10-5-5 shape (5 angles x 2 variations = 10 creatives, 5 copies, 5 headlines). 3-2-2 trackers remain valid against the legacy shape; this schema governs trackers where dct_structure.method == '10-5-5'. The sheet writer (scripts/ad_concept_sheet_writer.py) consumes creatives[] one-row-per-entry, so each ANGLE is one creatives[] entry -> one CREATIVES row + one COPY row (5 rows per wave). Full method spec: docs/methods/10-5-5/SPEC.md.

_method.description: Mirror of dct_structure.method for quick grep.

metrics_campaign.description: Routes the sheet write (buyer-funnel | asset-progression | ...). MUST match a metrics-config.json campaigns[].campaign_slug.

dct_number.description: The Flex wave id number (the 5 angles share this wave).

meta_adset_name.description: One Flex ad set holds all 5 angles' 10 images + 5 texts + 5 headlines.

angle_model.description: five_x_two is the locked default (D1, 2026-06-03). ten_distinct reserved for future discovery-mode waves.

headlines_drafted_per_angle.description: Over-draft pool (~5) narrowed to 1 locked. Drafts retained in creatives[].headline_drafts for audit.

creatives.description: Exactly 5 entries, one per angle. Each -> one CREATIVES row + one COPY row.

batch.description: Unique per angle, e.g. DCT010-A01 .. DCT010-A05. Writer keys CREATIVES dup-detection on this.

angle_rationale.description: Optional 3-paragraph strategic rationale (big-angle-spotter 07b). Preferred for the ANGLE sheet column when present.

persona.description: Canonical avatar id + display name, e.g. 'avatar-1 (The Hesitant Calculator)'. See clients/<client>/_brand/avatars/_index.md.

copy_1.description: The single LOCKED copy for this angle. (copy_2 stays empty in 10-5-5.)

copy_2.description: Unused in 10-5-5 (kept for 3-2-2 back-compat). Leave empty.

headline_1.description: The single LOCKED headline for this angle. (headline_2 stays empty.)

headline_drafts.description: ~5 drafted headlines for this angle before narrowing to headline_1. Audit trail; NOT written to the sheet.

canva_link.description: Real Canva URL. Writer refuses placeholder values (tbd/todo/pending/none/null/empty).

variations.description: The 2 image variants of THIS angle (same copy + headline). Feed image-gen; NOT written to the sheet (the row is angle-level).

row_count.description: 5 CREATIVES rows + 5 COPY rows per 10-5-5 wave.
